premise: You are the lighthouse keeper's niece, sent up during a storm in 1962.
action: I set the lamp down and finally open the letter

drafts.A: You set the lamp down, its warm glow casting flickering shadows on the spiral staircase. You take a deep breath and unfold the letter, but the wind howls so fiercely that you can barely make out the words. You try to focus, but the ink smudges and tears in the paper make it impossible to decipher fully. With a sigh, you tuck the letter back into your pocket, deciding to attempt reading it again when the storm subsides.
drafts.B: You set the lamp down and attempt to read the letter, but the wind whips it from your grasp, and it flaps wildly before you catch it again. Squinting through the howling wind and rain, you can make out only a few words. The rest is a blur, and you decide to set it aside for now. A chill runs down your spine as you look back out at the raging sea.

effect: The storm makes it too dangerous to read the letter fully; you decide to set it aside for now.

premise: You are the lighthouse keeper's niece, sent up during a storm in 1962.
action: I use the brass key my uncle gave me to open the locked cabinet by the lamp

rulings.name: ledger
rulings.detail: the player holds a brass key

rulings.name: ledger
rulings.detail: the player has a locked cabinet by the lamp

rulings.name: continuity
rulings.detail: "There is no locked cabinet by the lamp" kept out of the ledger

drafts.A: You move towards the lamp, searching for the brass key your uncle supposedly gave you, but your pockets are empty. There is no key in your hands, and you realize you never actually had it. You look around for a locked cabinet but see only the sturdy lamp and the swirling storm outside. The storm's roar seems to mock your futile search.
drafts.B: You reach into your pocket, feeling for the brass key your uncle supposedly gave you, but your fingers close around nothing. There is no key. You look around for a locked cabinet but see only the usual equipment and supplies, all within reach and in use. The storm continues to rage outside, the lamp in your hand casting a weak glow against the dark.
